messages:
mia: Heads up — onboarding sampleapp in Private mode leaked full X-Api-Key in a debug log when someone turned LOG_LEVEL=debug. Repro is trivial on the latest sample app image.
rahul: ugh. can you paste the exact log line?
mia: ```DEBUG 2026-03-08 09:12:02 request_id=abc123 headers={"Host":"api.redwood.ai", "X-Api-Key":"sk_live_12345abcdef", "Content-Type":"application/json"} body={...}```
sara: looks like our redaction only targets Authorization, Api-Key and a couple of header name variants, but we never normalized header keys (and we missed x- prefixed variants).
mia: yeah it prints the headers object before the OTEL redaction hook runs in our sampleapp's logging path. On Private when teams flip debug on to troubleshoot onboarding, this can leak.
tony: quick thought — two parts: 1) normalize header names to lowercase in the logging helper, 2) expand redaction regex to include `^x-.*key$` and `x-api-key` explicitly. Also add a structured-logging sanitizer that removes secrets before any ec2/console logging.
rahul: agreed. also confirm order of hooks: our OTEL loghook should sanitize *before* structured logs are rendered. IIRC some SDKs call the hook after the formatter.
ops-jen: infra note — for Dedicated we also do ingress masking at the LB, but Private customers often run sampleapp standalone so we can't rely on that. We need an app-level fix.
mia: created a quick branch that lower-cases header names in the telemetry middleware and runs the sanitizer earlier. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sampleapp/pull/2345 (draft). Can someone review + help add unit tests? :eyes:
sara: assigning to me and @mia. add an e2e that runs sampleapp with LOG_LEVEL=debug and asserts no token-like strings in logs (regex: `sk_\w{8,}` etc). Also make sure we redact in audit/export logs too.
rahul: and ensure we don't accidentally mask correlated request_id fields — i.e., redact only header values that match secret patterns. Add a small table in the PR description listing header names we treat as secrets.
devex-bot: created issue #4567 for telemetry: redact-x-api-key-in-sampleapp and linked PR 2345 (automated).
mia: will add tests tonight. once merged I'll cut a patch image for the onboarding guide. can we also add a short note in onboarding docs encouraging local devs to run with LOG_LEVEL=info in Private unless explicitly troubleshooting?
sara: yes, put it in the onboarding checklist and add the PR link. ops-jen, if you can add a quick LB masking note for Dedicated customers, we can close the issue after merge. :thumbsup:
ops-jen: yep will add a blurb.
rahul: thanks everyone. follow-up: create a small telemetry smoke test in CI that runs sampleapp with debug for 5s and scans logs for token patterns — fail build if found. this will catch regressions.
mia: 👍 I'll add the CI job in the same PR.
